subs.text: A platform built around Faisal — his brand, his name, his voice.
Not a website. A commercial engine: audience, sponsors, bookings and coaching revenue under one roof.
Training content structured like a season — the substance behind the profile.
The profile does the talking: global HYROX MC, bestselling author, celebrity trainer.
Coaching offers front and centre — one click becomes an application, not a DM.
Race calendar, crew, community — the audience lives on his platform, not a rented bio link.
His knowledge, in his voice — content that compounds instead of disappearing into a feed.
Ask Faisal — enquiries arrive structured, not buried in a DM queue.
The Warriors Wall — community proof at scale. These demo entries show the layout.
Fans submit shots; he approves. Community content, zero moderation overhead.
Coaching enquiries land as applications — qualified leads, not a payment link.
Race-mate board — a reason for athletes to register and keep returning.
They pair up on his platform. Retention without staff.
Race predictor — a tool athletes actually bookmark.
They enter a time; it predicts a finish. The platform becomes part of their training week.
Split analyser — paste a result, get a station-by-station breakdown.
Analysis that used to live in a spreadsheet — now it feeds his mailing list.
Results board — his times, his crew's times. An asset no Instagram post can replicate.
Eight stations, coached in his voice, shot with his race photos.
Run zone — pacing and compromised running, the work between the stations.
Taper zone — the week before race day, done properly.
Race calendar — where he's competing, where the community meets.
Race crew meetups — community organised on his own platform, not a group chat.
Fresh HYROX coverage under his name — the search engine that keeps the brand findable.
Partners page — PUMA, Everlast, Applied Nutrition. Sponsor inventory with measurable clicks.
Every partner click is a reportable conversion — data he can take back to sponsors.
Affiliate codes live inside his brand — traffic and data stay his, not a Linktree's.
That's the difference from a bio link — the audience, the clicks and the proof all sit on his brand.
Join the list — every visitor becomes a contact his business owns outright.
And the management layer — the Desk.
Coaching income, bookings, affiliate revenue, campaigns — one view, no spreadsheet.
Business management built in. He coaches; the platform keeps score.
This is a mockup — built to his spec, fast. Weeks, not months.
Worth a conversation. Happy to walk you through what it becomes with real content.
